batch: Power-plan desktop menu source review and registered VM access

legacySource.registrationBehavior: Writes the parent and child shell keys through merged HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT, creates entries only for four English names found by parsing powercfg /list output, and places direct powercfg.exe -setactive <GUID> commands in child command keys.
legacySource.removalBehavior: Recursively deletes the entire named HKCR subtree without capturing prior contents or proving RIDE ownership.
migrationImplications: The legacy source does not establish intended-user-only ownership; HKCR is a merged view.
Direct menu commands bypass the RIDE active-plan handler, saved-state capture and reporting.
Recursive removal can delete pre-existing or subsequently edited content under the same name.
A per-user native Power Options handoff remains the accepted initial design direction; any menu helper still needs an explicit physical path, ownership and recovery contract.
